description:
Useful Planetary Shield
v0.1.2 — for Starsector 0.98a-RC5

Download

UsefulPlanetaryShield-0.1.2.zip

Extract into your Starsector mods/ folder and enable it in the launcher.

Features

Makes the Planetary Shield industry actually absorb orbital bombardment - in vanilla it does nothing against it (only a x3 ground-defense multiplier, meteor suppression and a shield texture).
While the shield is operational (built and not disrupted), a tactical or saturation bombardment is largely absorbed:

Industry disruption cut to 50% of its normal duration
Stability loss from the bombardment cut to 50%
No pollution inflicted on habitable worlds
The colony cannot be reduced in size by a saturation strike
The colony cannot be decivilized, by bombardment or by stability collapse

Tradeoff: the vanilla x3 ground-defense bonus is removed - the shield stops bombs, not marines.
Absorbing a strike knocks the shield generator offline (at least 60 days for a tactical strike, the full halved disruption for a saturation strike), so a shielded colony shrugs off the first strike and is exposed until it repairs. A sustained campaign still gets through - you just cannot be one-shotted.
Works against every source of bombardment: Luddic Path, Remnant and Sindrian Diktat colony crises, and any modded faction that bombards you.
Configurable: disruption/stability percentages, individual toggles for the pollution / size / deciv protections, restore the vanilla ground-defense bonus, and restrict the effect to player colonies only.
For Starsector 0.98a-RC5. LunaLib optional (in-game config menu; otherwise reads data/config/settings.json). Safe to add to an existing save; safe to remove after turning off "Block Decivilization" and loading+saving once. Conflicts with any mod that replaces the vanilla planetaryshield industry plugin.

Recommended mod collection for ultimate late game experience

Standalone, safe to add mid-save, can be run together or separately.

Threat Incursion — the threat colonizes the sector and invades the core worlds. Disrupt their supply chains and besiege the entrenched hives into decline.
Commerce Wars — dominate a faction's markets or the military balance and they push back: ultimatums, tribute, enforcement fleets.
Piracy Reworked — the underworld runs on your money: black-market trade funds a self-sustaining pirate war economy.
Remnant Retribution — a late-game colony crisis.
Useful Planetary Shield — planetary shields finally do something: they absorb orbital bombardment.

Disclaimer: This post and mod were written using Claude's Fable AI model.
